metadata.description: Channel and tooling plugins for Claude Code, maintained by RIA Systems (verified Meta Tech Provider).

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: WhatsApp channel for Claude Code — messaging bridge built on the official Meta Cloud API, with built-in access control. Manage pairing, allowlists, and policy via /whatsapp:access.

plugins.name: instagram
plugins.description: Answer Instagram DMs and comments faster: paste a conversation or a screenshot and get a reply drafted in your voice, a quick read of the lead and a suggested next step. Skills only; nothing is sent on your behalf.

plugins.name: instagram-local
plugins.description: Instagram channel for Claude Code that runs on your machine with your own Meta app: inbound comments and DMs arrive as channel messages, replies go out through the official Instagram API. Needs a Meta app and an HTTPS tunnel.
